question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting or backporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close this issue and the open closing PR as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can prove the latest release helper is affected and the old-surface PR fixes that parser, but current main removed the helper and repository guidance now points durable skill creation at Skill Workshop.

options.title: Close Obsolete Helper Path
options.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported skill-creation path.

options.title: Sponsor Legacy Helper Repair
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR that intentionally restores or backports the helper, adds mixed-case parser coverage, and states the supported release story.

recommendation.title: Close Obsolete Helper Path
recommendation.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported skill-creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original helper and the current simplified skill-creator direction both route most strongly through steipete-authored history.
